title: 静电与防爆电气
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/106_静电与防爆电气.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/106_静电与防爆电气/src.py

points.K1: 静电：电荷积聚，走路也会带电
points.K2: 静电放电能点燃蒸气粉尘，损坏元件
points.K3: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
points.K5: 电压等级和防爆分区是两回事
points.K6: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区
points.K7: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣摸门把手，指尖冒出一个小火花，吓一跳
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot touches a metal door handle and a tiny spark jumps from its paw, making it flinch.
shots.narration: 这一课讲静电与防爆电气。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰穿着化纤外套，从大桶往小瓶倒溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a synthetic fleece jacket pours solvent from a large drum into a small bottle.
shots.narration: 阿杰穿着化纤外套倒溶剂。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 溶剂哗哗冲下，瓶口有一个小火花图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: solvent splashing fast into the bottle, a small spark icon at the bottle mouth. No text.
shots.narration: 倒得又快又急，静电在积聚。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研叫停他，指向墙边的接地夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to an earthing clamp on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研喊停：先接地，再慢慢倒。

shots.section_title: 静电：电荷积聚，走路也会带电
shots.scene: 物体表面聚满正负电荷符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the surface of an object covered with plus and minus charge symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 电荷积聚在物体表面，就是静电。
overlay: 静电：电荷积聚，走路也会带电

shots.section_title: 静电：电荷积聚，走路也会带电
shots.scene: 人走过地毯，身上的电荷越来越多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person walking across a carpet, charge symbols building up on the body. No text.
shots.narration: 走过地毯，身上就会带静电。

shots.section_title: 静电：电荷积聚，走路也会带电
shots.scene: 摩擦、倾倒、过滤、流动四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, rubbing, pouring, filtering and liquid flowing through a pipe, each producing charges. No text.
shots.narration: 摩擦、倾倒、流动，都会起电。

shots.section_title: 静电：电荷积聚，走路也会带电
shots.scene: 干燥天气里，静电更容易积聚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry air icon with more charge symbols piling up. No text.
shots.narration: 天气越干燥，静电越多。

shots.section_title: 静电放电能点燃蒸气粉尘，损坏元件
shots.scene: 手指靠近金属，电荷放出一个小火花
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger approaching metal and a small spark jumping across the gap. No text.
shots.narration: 电荷放出来，就是一个小火花。
overlay: 静电放电能点燃蒸气粉尘，损坏元件

shots.section_title: 静电放电能点燃蒸气粉尘，损坏元件
shots.scene: 火花碰到溶剂蒸气云，变成火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spark meeting a cloud of solvent vapour and turning into a flame icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 能点燃易燃蒸气和气体。

shots.section_title: 静电放电能点燃蒸气粉尘，损坏元件
shots.scene: 火花碰到悬浮粉尘云，爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spark meeting a cloud of fine dust in the air, an explosion icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 也能点燃可燃粉尘。

shots.section_title: 静电放电能点燃蒸气粉尘，损坏元件
shots.scene: 电路板上的芯片被火花击出一个黑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spark hitting a chip on a circuit board and leaving a dark burn spot. No text.
shots.narration: 还会击坏精密电子元件。

shots.section_title: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
shots.scene: 易燃溶剂旁，一点火花就危险
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable liquid container with vapour above it and a small spark, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂旁，一点静电火花就危险。
overlay: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒

shots.section_title: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
shots.scene: 大桶接地，大桶和小桶之间夹跨接线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal drum connected to an earth point, and a bonding wire clamped between the drum and the receiving can. No text.
shots.narration: 容器接地，两只容器跨接相连。

shots.section_title: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
shots.scene: 【实拍】把接地跨接线的夹子夹到两只空金属容器的裸金属处（容器为空或只盛清水）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands clipping a bonding wire clamp onto bare metal on two empty metal containers, another lead to an earth point.
shots.narration: 夹子夹在裸金属上，接触要牢。

shots.section_title: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
shots.scene: 液流贴着瓶壁缓缓流下；高处冲下打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid running slowly down the inside wall of a container with a tick, and liquid splashing from height crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 慢慢倒，贴壁流，不高处冲。

shots.section_title: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
shots.scene: 棉质实验服打钩，化纤衣物打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cotton lab coat with a tick and a synthetic fleece jacket crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 穿棉质实验服，少穿化纤衣物。

shots.section_title: 转移易燃溶剂：接地跨接，慢慢倒
shots.scene: 在通风柜内转移，远离点火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: solvent being transferred inside a fume hood, ignition sources kept away. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风处操作，远离点火源。

shots.section_title: 防静电的通用措施
shots.scene: 接地、增湿、防静电用品三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an earth symbol, a humidifier and antistatic shoes. No text.
shots.narration: 防静电，主要靠这几招。

shots.section_title: 防静电的通用措施
shots.scene: 金属管道、容器、设备都连到接地线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: metal pipes, containers and equipment all connected to a common earth bar. No text.
shots.narration: 金属设备和容器，可靠接地。

shots.section_title: 防静电的通用措施
shots.scene: 湿度计指针升到适中范围
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hygrometer needle rising into a moderate range, fewer charge symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 保持适当湿度，静电少积聚。

shots.section_title: 防静电的通用措施
shots.scene: 进入易燃场所前，手摸人体静电释放器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student touches a static discharge post with his bare hand before entering a flammable storage room.
shots.narration: 进易燃场所前，先释放身上静电。

shots.section_title: 防静电的通用措施
shots.scene: 防静电鞋和防静电工作服
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: antistatic shoes and an antistatic work suit. No text.
shots.narration: 需要时，穿防静电服和鞋。

shots.section_title: 防静电的通用措施
shots.scene: 塑料桶装易燃溶剂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plain plastic bucket filled with flammable solvent, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃液体，用合格容器装。

shots.section_title: 碰电路板先防静电
shots.scene: 电路板上芯片旁有静电敏感符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circuit board with an electrostatic sensitive device symbol next to a chip. No text.
shots.narration: 电路板的元件，怕静电。

shots.section_title: 碰电路板先防静电
shots.scene: 【实拍】手腕戴上防静电腕带，夹子夹到防静电台垫的接地端子（设备已断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wrist strap being put on and its clip attached to the earth terminal of an antistatic bench mat, the device switched off.
shots.narration: 要碰电路板，先戴防静电腕带。

shots.section_title: 碰电路板先防静电
shots.scene: 拆下的电路板放进防静电袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a removed circuit board being placed on and into an antistatic bag. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下的板件，放在防静电袋上。

shots.section_title: 碰电路板先防静电
shots.scene: 手指直接摸芯片引脚，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bare fingers touching the pins of a chip, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拿板子拿边缘，不摸引脚。

shots.section_title: 碰电路板先防静电
shots.scene: 先断电再打开设备，交合格人员维修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a device unplugged first, then opened by the facility engineer. No text.
shots.narration: 维修先断电，交合格人员做。

shots.section_title: 电压等级和防爆分区是两回事
shots.scene: 左边电压阶梯，右边易燃气体云，中间等号打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage staircase on the left, a flammable gas cloud on the right, an equals sign between them crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电压等级和防爆分区，是两回事。
overlay: 电压等级和防爆分区是两回事

shots.section_title: 电压等级和防爆分区是两回事
shots.scene: 电压阶梯：看电压高低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage staircase with a meter icon. No text.
shots.narration: 电压等级，看的是电压高低。

shots.section_title: 电压等级和防爆分区是两回事
shots.scene: 易燃气体云和粉尘云：看易燃易爆物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable gas cloud and a dust cloud with a magnifying glass. No text.
shots.narration: 防爆分区，看有没有易燃易爆物。

shots.section_title: 电压等级和防爆分区是两回事
shots.scene: 两份不同的标准书图标，分开放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two different standards book icons placed apart. No text.
shots.narration: 两者没有对应关系，别混用。

shots.section_title: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区
shots.scene: 易燃气体可能出现的时间长短，三个色块
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three coloured zones around a solvent tank, from always present to rarely present. No text.
shots.narration: 爆炸危险区域，按危险程度分区。
overlay: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区

shots.section_title: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区
shots.scene: 0区、1区、2区由内向外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: nested zones around an open solvent vessel, innermost always, middle sometimes, outer rarely. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃气体环境，分0区、1区、2区。

shots.section_title: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区
shots.scene: 粉尘环境另一组分区图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dust handling machine with its own set of nested zones. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃粉尘环境，另有分区。

shots.section_title: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区
shots.scene: 一本标准书和防爆标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a standards book icon next to an explosion proof equipment marking. No text.
shots.narration: 怎么划分，以现行国家标准为准。

shots.section_title: 爆炸危险区域按危险程度分区
shots.scene: 危险区域内，配上相应的防爆灯和防爆开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: explosion proof lamps and switches installed inside a hazardous zone. No text.
shots.narration: 危险区域里，用相应的防爆电器。

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 实验室里的溶剂库、气瓶间图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent store room and a gas cylinder room in a lab building. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室也有易燃易爆场所。
overlay: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 把普通电暖器、插线板带进溶剂库，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ordinary heater and a power strip being carried into a solvent store, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 非防爆电器，不带进这些地方。

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 【实拍】防爆冰箱门上的防爆标志和铭牌特写（遮挡品牌和型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the explosion proof marking and rating plate on the door of a flammable storage refrigerator.
shots.narration: 易燃试剂要冷藏，用防爆冰箱。

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 普通家用冰箱里放乙醚瓶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle of volatile solvent inside an ordinary household fridge with a spark from the light switch, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 普通冰箱有火花，不放易燃品。

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 通风柜里用溶剂，加热器电源插在柜外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: solvent used inside a fume hood while the heater power plug is placed outside the hood. No text.
shots.narration: 通风柜里用溶剂，电源放柜外。

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 通风良好，蒸气被抽走不积聚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: vapour being drawn away by ventilation so it does not build up. No text.
shots.narration: 保持通风，不让易燃气体积聚。

shots.section_title: 实验室易燃场所用防爆电器
shots.scene: 防爆电器由专业人员选型安装，不私自改装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer installing an explosion proof fitting, a student modification crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 防爆电器专业选装，不私改。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 接地夹、腕带、湿度计三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an earthing clamp, an antistatic wrist strap and a hygrometer. No text.
shots.narration: 接地跨接、慢倒、戴腕带防静电。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 防爆标志和溶剂库
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an explosion proof marking next to a solvent store room. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃场所，用防爆电器。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣把灭火器抱在身边挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：电气火灾的预防与扑救。
